product_metadata.title: Mangobox Window Privacy Film Frosted Glass Window Film Home Window Tint for Bathroom Office Sun Blocking Static Cling Strips Blinds 17.7 inch x 78.7 inch
features: ✔ REUSABLE & RECYCLED-- This privacy window film is static cling without adhesive,super easy to do application on smooth window glass surface,and it can be removable and reusable.
✔GLARE CONTROL & UV BLOCK: Heat insulation in the summer and heat preservation in the winter.This glass window film blocks up to 75% UV rays,well protects your furniture,flooring from color fading.

✔ ECONOMICAL & EASY APPLICATION: No more heavy & troublesome curtains or blinds,by using this high quality frosted window film,it will be an easy thing to decorative your glass surface with fashion blinds design in the Bathroom,Kitchen,Office,Living Room and more place in minutes.
✔ PRIVACY PROTECTION:Provides Privacy and Allows the Lights in.

✔ INSTALLATION TIPS:▲Please make sure the window surface, edges and corners are clean enough without any dust and remember to peel off the clear backing film before installation; ▲Please must peel off backing protective film when do application▲Please spray a lot of water both on the window surface and window film back during installation for effective attachment.
